The '''''Profit''''' was a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] commanded by [[Dool Pundar]]. The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] absconded with his vessel during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and was still using it at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was abandoned after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] crashed onboard.

==Characteristics==
[[Dool Pundar]]'s [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was a modified [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].<ref name="Wizard" /> It was equipped with a [[Core ship/Legends|centersphere]] and two cargo arms.<ref name="Expanded VD" /> The vessel was circular, with the arms terminating in a crescent-shape. Three [[Engine/Legends|engines]] propelled the vessel through [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> Like other vessels of its class manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]], it was 3,170 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter.<ref name="CCS" /> The [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] was equipped with [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and had turreted weapons on the top of the right arm. It had a force of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s<ref name="Strange Allies" /> and approximately 100 [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="Wizard" />

==History==
[[File:Absconding_with_freighter.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The pirate ship capturing Noggox's freighter.]]
The ''Profit'' served in the [[Trade Federation fleet/Legends|Trade Federation Defense Fleet]] until the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]], when it was highjacked by Pundar and several of his associates, who proceeded to space their shipmates using reprogrammed battle droids.<ref name="Wizard" />

Pundar became a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and used the ''Profit'' as his headquarters. Despite being hunted by both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces, the ship evaded capture and eventually amassed a small fleet of minor [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="Wizard" />

[[22 BBY/Legends|Years]]<ref name="TCW Timeline">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Pundar and his vessel captured a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]], which belonged to [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Pundar mercifully let the crew depart while he and his ''Lucrehulk'' took off from the area. Pundar subsequently set up position in the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] at the behest of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]],<ref name="Strange Allies" /> a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and now leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="SWE1">{{Film|II}}</ref> Pundar planned on capturing Noggox's last freighter, which was carrying [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When it arrived, Pundar launched twelve of his Vulture starfighters to [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|attack]]. The freighter had a Jedi escort, though, and [[Nuru Kungurama]] was able to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] the freighter to a crash-landing in one of the ''Lucrehulk's'' cargo arms. A [[Unidentified Neimoidian pirate|pirate]] informed Pundar of the infiltration, who ordered the crew to abandon ship. The pirate ship was then seized by the [[Fondor Space Patrol]].<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Lucrehulk''-class pirate ship was first mentioned in a [[Wizards.com]] article for a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] storyline, [[Bounty Postings|''Dool Pundar: Pirate Lord'']]. The ship later appeared in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'' comic.
